title: Size of the Repair and the Ridgeline Tool Rental Damage Deductible
content:
On Ridgeline Tool Rental agreements with damage protection, the size of the repair assessed at the return inspection sets how the damage deductible is figured.

**Rule.** The size of the repair sets how the damage deductible is figured: when the repair cost assessed at inspection is 10000.00 dollars or more, the deductible is the class deductible plus 2 percent of the repair cost above 10000.00 dollars; when the repair cost is below 1500.00 dollars, the deductible is 25 percent of the repair cost; when the repair cost is 1500.00 dollars or more but below 10000.00 dollars, the deductible is the class deductible.

The repair cost is the repair cost recorded on the return inspection line of the agreement. The amount so figured is not rounded; the rounding to the cent is made only on the final figure.

## Class deductible per incident (damage protection schedule)

| Equipment class | Class deductible, USD |
|---|---|
| Ridgeline Rental Hand and Power Tools | 0.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Floor and Surface Care | 0.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Lawn and Landscape | 0.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Concrete and Masonry | 0.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting | 250.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment | 500.00 |

## Repair size bands

| Repair cost assessed | Deductible figured as |
|---|---|
| 10000.00 or more | the class deductible plus 2 percent of the repair cost above 10000.00 |
| 1500.00 up to 9999.99 | the class deductible |
| below 1500.00 | 25 percent of the repair cost |

## Worked figures (hypothetical repairs)

| Class | Repair cost | Deductible figured |
|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment | 12000.00 | 500.00 plus 2 percent of 2000.00, that is 540.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment | 10000.00 | 500.00 plus 2 percent of 0.00, that is 500.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment | 1500.00 | 500.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting | 1200.00 | 25 percent of 1200.00, that is 300.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Floor and Surface Care | 800.00 | 25 percent of 800.00, that is 200.00 |
